screen.player2npc.ui.getting_started.bod: Welcome to your AI companions - what they are and how to begin
screen.player2npc.ui.getting_started.tal: How to talk to your bot

By default, companions only respond to chat messages that include their name. This keeps Joules usage from getting out of hand when you have many bots or play on multiplayer. Want a bot to respond to every message? Turn off %1$s in the Behavior tab.
screen.player2npc.ui.getting_started.tro: • Check that the Player2 app is running.
• Don't want to use the app? Make sure the mod is authorized.
• Still not working? Get help on the Player2 Discord.
screen.player2npc.ui.getting_started.jou: • Grab your daily spin on the Battery page under "Get Js Free".
• Select the free models in the app/website: Chat - %1$s, Voice - %2$s.
• Subscribe to %1$s for daily Js - best value to get the most out of the mod.
• Or use pay-as-you-go for an immediate injection of Js.

help.player2npc.cleanup-clones.long: Scans every loaded dimension for a second copy of one of your companions that was accidentally spawned when you changed dimension. Only removes a clone that is loaded, provably not your active companion, and not currently running a task — your real companion and any companion that is merely out of a loaded chunk are never touched.

screen.player2npc.ui.settings.panel.subt: These settings apply to companions on this world or server.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.admin_requ: Only a server operator or the singleplayer owner can change these settings.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.status.sav: Saved. The live update is pending and will apply when current work allows.

screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.command: Short prefix used to recognize companion commands. Use 1 to 8 characters with no spaces or control characters.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.resourc: How far a companion searches for dropped items while collecting resources. Set to 0 to turn this search off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.minimum: Start collecting food when the companion's carried food falls below this many hunger points.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.foodUni: Keep collecting until the companion carries this many hunger points of food. Set to 0 to turn food collection off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.resourc: How far resource tasks search for a chest containing needed items. Set to 0 to turn chest lookup off.
How far resource tasks search for blocks that can supply a needed item. Set to 0 to turn this search off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.avoidSe: Skip dungeon and loot chests when looking for storage containers.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.avoidOc: Treat blocks classified as ocean terrain as areas to avoid while pathfinding.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.entityR: Maximum distance from which a companion can interact with or attack an entity.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.collect: Prioritize a nearby dropped pickaxe before collecting other resources.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.mobDefe: Allow companions to defend themselves automatically against hostile mobs.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.forceFi: Controls how automatic close-range defensive attacks are scheduled.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.dodgePr: Allow companions to evade incoming projectiles automatically.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.killOrA: Allow companions to attack or avoid hostile mobs that interfere with tasks.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.avoidDr: Allow companions to seek air before they run out of breath.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.extingu: Allow companions to place water to extinguish themselves when burning.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.autoEat: Allow companions to eat carried food when hunger requires it.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.hungerE: Run the companion hunger simulation. Turning this off also prevents automatic eating.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.autoMLG: Allow companions to use a water bucket automatically to survive dangerous falls.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.overwor: Choose how a companion handles travel from the Overworld into the Nether.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.netherF: Maximum direct walking distance considered before Nether fast travel is preferred.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.idleCom: Command to start when a companion becomes inactive. Leave it blank to keep the companion idle.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.fastCra: Use purpose-built fast crafting routines when a supported recipe is requested.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.craftDe: Delay between crafting actions. The UI value is measured in milliseconds.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.craftTa: How long the companion looks at a crafting table before using it. The UI value is measured in milliseconds.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.preferL: Use a suitable nearby crafting table before obtaining or placing a new one.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.craftin: Search range for a pathable existing crafting table before placing a new table.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.enableA: Allow the model-backed planner to build supported multi-step companion tasks.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.enableL: Allow the look-at-owner task while idle and after a command finishes or fails.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.agentic: Number of relevant command references retrieved for each agentic planning request.
Maximum number of steps the agentic planner may produce for one task.
Fall back to built-in gathering behavior when an agentic gathering plan cannot be produced.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.gatherL: How far an agentic gathering step searches for dropped item entities.
Maximum number of loose items one agentic gathering step may collect.
Maximum time allowed for one loose-item gathering step.
Wait after the last pickup before a loose-item gathering step completes. The UI value is measured in milliseconds.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.agentic: Search range for suitable existing storage and marked tool sources.
Search range around the companion for a safe place to put a new storage chest.
Maximum distance an agentic task may travel to an unmarked, automatically discovered source or chest.
Allow agentic tasks to place a new chest when no suitable existing storage is available.
Prefer a suitable existing chest instead of placing a new one.
Prevent agentic storage tasks from using discovered loot chests.
Maximum time allowed to find, reach, or place storage for an agentic task.
Maximum time allowed for an agentic deposit step.
Keep tools in the companion's inventory instead of depositing them with task materials.
Allow agentic storage tasks to place a sign label on a chest.
Maximum time allowed for a chest-labeling step.
Allow a model call to propose chest-label text instead of using only deterministic text.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.enableD: Allow agentic tasks to schedule smelting work through the deferred-smelt workflow.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.deferre: Maximum number of input items in one deferred smelting batch.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.enableS: Allow agentic tasks to use smithing-table upgrade recipes.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.smithMa: Maximum number of items processed in one smithing step.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.deferre: Number of unchanged progress checks allowed before deferred smelting is treated as stalled.
Maximum total time allowed for one deferred smelting job.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.aggrega: Radius around the companion used to count matching dropped items toward task totals. Set to 0 to turn this counting off.
Radius around a local source used to include related source blocks in task totals. Set to 0 to turn this counting off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.mineCol: Wait after mining so dropped resources can be collected before totals are checked. The UI value is measured in milliseconds.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.wanderB: Default maximum time for bounded recovery wandering. Set to 0 to turn bounded wandering off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.wanderN: Stop recovery wandering after this long without pathing improvement. Set to 0 to turn this early stop off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.ellieGp: Enable inventory and farm waypoint creation, lookup, auditing, and memory.
Omit a container's full item snapshot when its used slots exceed this limit; EllieGPS still saves keywords.
Use asynchronous summarization to polish inventory and storage waypoint descriptions. Farm descriptions stay deterministic.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.throwaw: Items eligible to be discarded when inventory cleanup needs space.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.dontThr: Never discard an otherwise throwaway item if it has a custom name.
Never discard an otherwise throwaway item if it is enchanted.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.throwAw: Allow inventory cleanup to discard configured throwaway items that are no longer needed.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.importa: Items treated as important and protected during inventory decisions.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.limitFu: Restrict fuel checks that honor this setting to the supported-fuels list. Smelting fuel planning may also use vanilla-valid fuels.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.pe.support: Fuel items accepted by checks governed by the supported-fuels restriction. Smelting fuel planning may independently use vanilla-valid fuels.

screen.player2npc.ui.settings.status.loa: A settings file could not be loaded. Its rows are read-only until the file is corrected.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.pay: Choose whether each person who prompts a companion pays for their own requests or the companion owner pays for all requests.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.own: Allow owner-paid companion requests to continue after the owner disconnects when the dedicated client proxy is available.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.cal: Only deliver chat to a companion when the message begins with that character's name or short name.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.max: Maximum number of one player's AI companions that may be alive in the world at once.
Maximum number of distinct character IDs stored on disk for each player. Set to 0 for no limit.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.cha: Maximum output-token budget for chat-completion requests built by the mod.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.ser: On dedicated servers, use the server's companion lifecycle settings instead of each player's choices. Integrated worlds always use server settings.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.bot: Choose whether companions follow the world's keepInventory game rule or always keep or drop their inventory.
Allow an owner's client to report when companion speech finishes so the speaking cooldown can clear early.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.rag: Use the full command list when live retrieval fails instead of using only the always-included core commands.
Retrieve and inject only commands relevant to the current goal. Turning this off restores the full command list.
Minimum alphanumeric goal length required before live command retrieval runs.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.dee: Maximum deep-check rephrase attempts allowed in one model turn. Set to 0 to turn these attempts off.
Maximum deep-check model calls allowed in each rate-limit window. Set to 0 for no limit.
Length of the rolling window used by the deep-check call limit.
Treat retrieval as weak when its best score is below this percentage threshold.
Treat retrieval as ambiguous when the gap between leading results is below this percentage.
Treat retrieval as weak when less than this percentage of the goal's tokens are covered.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.for: Force a deep check when ordinary retrieval returns no usable result.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.mem: Length of the rolling window used by the memory-pipeline call limit.
Minimum number of eligible turns buffered before a memory extraction runs. This cannot exceed the batch maximum.
Maximum number of eligible turns retained in the extraction buffer; older excess turns are dropped. This cannot be below the batch minimum.
Minimum eligible text length for zero-model-call memory extraction.
Maximum breadth-first graph distance explored around a retrieved memory.
Maximum number of nodes visited while building a retrieved memory's local graph.
Maximum memory text injected into the per-turn prompt. A value of 0 uses the built-in default cap; it does not turn memory off.
Minimum retrieval confidence required before a memory is treated as sufficiently supported.
Per-game-hour recency multiplier expressed in thousandths. For example, 995 means a multiplier of 0.995.
Maximum number of scored memory results injected into one model turn.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.ref: Cumulative memory importance required before a reflection is triggered.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.rel: Maximum relationship-summary text included in the prompt prefix. Set to 0 to turn relationship summaries off.
screen.player2npc.ui.settings.server.mod: Inspect registered mod content during the next server launch. Changing this setting does not start an inspection immediately.
Maximum registered entries inspected during one launch. Set to 0 for no limit.
Stop launch-time mod-intelligence enrichment after this many failed enrichment calls.
Maximum number of mod-intelligence results returned for one query.
Minimum confidence required for a mod-intelligence result to be treated as a match.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-all.short: Operator: remove duplicate companion clones for every online player.
help.player2npc.cleanup-clones-all.long: Runs the clone cleanup once per currently online player. Offline players are skipped (their canonical companion mapping cannot be safely resolved while they are offline).
